recipes.name: Cinnamon-Spiced Orange & Thyme Mocktail
instructions: Add the water, maple syrup, thyme sprigs, and cinnamon to a small pan. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it steep for about 3 minutes. Then let it cool to room temperature.
Fill a shaker or mason jar halfway with ice cubes and strain in the thyme syrup. Add the grated ginger and lemon juice and shake well for 10 seconds*.
Divide the ice cubes between your cups, strain the contents from the shaker over top, and add the orange juice and ginger ale in equal parts.

page_recipe_notes: Notes * To turn this mocktail into a cocktail, simply add your favourite whiskey to the shaker.
Storage The syrup can be stored in an airtight container or mason jar in the fridge for up to 5 days. The assembled drink is best when enjoyed immediately.
